description: Call one view/pure function of an EVM contract via eth_call and return the ABI-decoded result. A failed or reverted read returns ok=false with an error code, never a zero. Read-only; nothing is signed or sent. Powered by blocktools (ABI coding). How to combine this with the other tools: swapchan_playbook (workflows: find-money, best-swap, rebalance, revoke-approvals, bridge-stuck, token-safety, recover-old-wallet).

abi.description: Optional ABI JSON to use instead of the Sourcify / Etherscan lookup (labelled as pasted; not checked against source).

args.description: Arguments in order; arrays/tuples as JSON lists, big numbers as decimal strings.

chainId.description: EVM chain id or name (1 eth, 8453 base, 42161 arbitrum, 10 optimism, 137 polygon, 56 bnb, 43114 avalanche, 59144 linea, 534352 scroll).

function.description: Function name, or the full signature for overloads, e.g. "balanceOf" or "get(uint256)"

name: contract_read
title: Read a contract function (eth_call)
